04764 Merab {may-rawb'}

源自 07231; 陰性專有名詞 人名

AV - Merab 3; 3

米拉 = "加增"
1) 掃羅王的長女; 原已許給大衛為妻, 但卻嫁給了米何拉人亞得列 (#撒上 14:49;18:17,19|)
record.edic_text:
04764 Merab {may-rawb'}

from 07231;; n pr f

AV - Merab 3; 3

Merab = "increase"
1) the eldest daughter of king Saul; promised to David but given
   instead to Adriel the Meholathite; mother of 5 children
